description: Bidirectional basin model: P_avg = eta * 0.5*rho*g*A*h^2/T_tide (both ebb and flood generation); offshore enclosed lagoon

unit.name: Generic Tidal Lagoon (Bidirectional)
unit.source: Aggidis & Feather (2012) Tidal Lagoons; Xiao et al. (2020) Tidal Lagoon Power; Tidal Lagoon Swansea Bay (2015) Scoping Report

A_lagoon.note: Lagoon plan area (e.g., Swansea Bay ~11.5 km2)

h_tidal.note: Mean tidal range amplitude (half peak-to-trough); smaller range acceptable vs barrage

eta_plant.note: Overall plant efficiency; slightly lower than barrage (bidirectional turbines ~25%)

n_cycles_per_period.note: Both ebb AND flood generation (bidirectional) = 2 generation cycles per tidal period

h_min_operation.note: Minimum head difference for generation (lower than barrage due to bidirectional capability)
